critical_findings.vulnerability: Hardcoded JWT Secret in Production Configuration
critical_findings.description: JWT secret is hardcoded in configuration files and visible in repository
critical_findings.impact: Complete authentication bypass, unauthorized access to all user data, privilege escalation
critical_findings.exploitation_scenario: Attacker extracts JWT secret from publicly visible configuration, generates arbitrary tokens for any user including admin accounts

mandatory_mitigation.code_diff: Remove hardcoded JWT_SECRET from wrangler.toml and .dev.vars. Use Cloudflare Workers environment variables or secrets management.

critical_findings.description: CSP allows 'unsafe-inline' for scripts and styles, enabling XSS attacks
critical_findings.impact: Cross-site scripting attacks, data theft, session hijacking
critical_findings.exploitation_scenario: Attacker injects malicious scripts through user input that bypasses CSP due to 'unsafe-inline' directive

critical_findings.description: Array inputs (nodes, edges) lack maximum length validation, enabling DoS attacks
critical_findings.impact: Denial of service through memory exhaustion, application crashes
critical_findings.exploitation_scenario: Attacker sends requests with extremely large arrays causing memory exhaustion and service unavailability

critical_findings.description: Detailed error messages and stack traces exposed in development mode, sensitive information leaked
critical_findings.impact: Information leakage about system internals, database structure, file paths
critical_findings.exploitation_scenario: Attacker gathers intelligence about system architecture through verbose error messages to plan targeted attacks

mandatory_mitigation.code_diff: Return generic error messages in all environments, log detailed errors server-side only

critical_findings.description: Rate limiting uses in-memory Map without persistence, easily bypassed
critical_findings.impact: Brute force attacks, resource exhaustion, DDoS attacks
critical_findings.exploitation_scenario: Attacker performs distributed brute force attacks on authentication endpoints, bypassing in-memory rate limiting

mandatory_mitigation.code_diff: Implement Cloudflare Durable Objects or KV-based rate limiting with proper cleanup
configuration_changes: Deploy Durable Object for rate limiting

critical_findings.description: CORS allows HTTP localhost origins even in non-development environments
critical_findings.impact: Man-in-the-middle attacks, credential theft, session hijacking
critical_findings.exploitation_scenario: Attacker intercepts unencrypted API communications when HTTP origins are allowed

mandatory_mitigation.code_diff: Remove HTTP origins from production CORS configuration, add HSTS headers

critical_findings.vulnerability: SQL Injection Risk in Dynamic Queries
critical_findings.description: Dynamic SQL query construction without proper parameterization in snippet filtering
critical_findings.impact: Database compromise, data theft, privilege escalation
critical_findings.exploitation_scenario: Attacker crafts malicious category parameters to inject SQL and extract sensitive data or escalate privileges

mandatory_mitigation.code_diff: Replace dynamic query building with prepared statements and parameter binding for all database operations

critical_findings.description: Password validation only checks minimum length, no complexity requirements
critical_findings.impact: Account compromise through brute force, dictionary attacks
critical_findings.exploitation_scenario: Attacker uses common password lists to compromise user accounts with weak passwords

mandatory_implementations: Implement Helmet.js with strict CSP configuration
Deploy proper secrets management (Cloudflare Workers Secrets)
Configure distributed rate limiting with Durable Objects
Implement parameterized queries for all database operations
Add comprehensive input validation with length limits
Implement structured error logging without information disclosure

issues: Multi-tenant isolation implemented but needs verification

compliance_requirements.ccpa: FAIL - No data subject rights implementation
compliance_requirements.soc2: FAIL - Insufficient access controls and monitoring
compliance_requirements.pci_dss: N/A - No payment card data processing detected

attack_scenarios.name: Authentication Bypass
steps: Extract hardcoded JWT secret from public repository
Generate valid JWT tokens for any user account
Access all user data and administrative functions

attack_scenarios.name: SQL Injection Attack
steps: Identify dynamic query construction in snippet filtering
Craft malicious category parameter with SQL payload
Extract sensitive data or escalate privileges

attack_scenarios.name: Cross-Site Scripting
steps: Inject malicious scripts through user input
Steal session tokens or perform unauthorized actions

immediate_actions: Remove hardcoded secrets from all configuration files
Implement Cloudflare Workers Secrets for JWT_SECRET
Deploy strict Content Security Policy without unsafe-inline
Add parameterized queries for all database operations
Implement proper error handling without information disclosure
short_term_goals: Deploy distributed rate limiting with Durable Objects
Add comprehensive input validation with size limits
long_term_strategy: Add penetration testing to CI/CD workflow
Add advanced threat detection and response

audit_summary.deployment_recommendation: BLOCK - Critical vulnerabilities must be remediated before production deployment
